description: Frozen LLHB v1 treatment surface: the tool names and schema hash the pinned local `lovspor mcp` server serves. The surface is a pure function of lovspor code (corpus-independent), so a unit test regenerates this document from the code on every run; if the served surface changes, that test fails and changing this file is an explicit apparatus decision, not drift. check_fairness.py reads it as the expectation the declared tool_config is compared against.
